The [[Herald of Purity]] is a member of the [[Ministry of Purity]]. He offers [[Memories of Purity]], a [[quest]] that allows players to restore [[explorable area]]s to their default pre-[[Winds of Change]] [[spawn]]s.

==Dialogue==
: ''"Look around you and tell me what you see. Is it despair? A crumbling city, barely standing on its shaky foundations? I will tell you what I see: possibilities. There is no such thing as a lost cause so long as the people possess the will to change. I believe that we can save this great city, and I believe that its people can be something greater."''
